assertions.name: vol_borromean_registry_matches_8G
assertions.source: |VOL_BORROMEAN_50DPS_STR − 8·G| = 2.29259e-50; the registry literal against mpmath's Catalan constant

assertions.name: vol_4_1_registry_matches_2_clausen_pi_over_3
assertions.source: |VOL_4_1_50DPS_STR − 2·Cl₂(π/3)| = 4.15965e-52. Gated at 1e-45, the same as its Borromean sibling above. This ran at 1e-33 until 2026-08-30 because the registry string was correct to only ~36 significant digits despite its _50DPS_ name; that literal has since been corrected, so the loosened gate has no remaining reason to exist — left in place it would be green-by-omission across 12 orders of magnitude

assertions.name: non_hyperbolic_knots_carry_zero_volume
assertions.source: Vol(⊙) = Vol(3_1) = 0 — neither complement admits a hyperbolic structure; ⊙ being the additive identity is what makes Geom_ε(N·⊙) = N·ε meaningful at all

assertions.name: disjoint_union_volumes_are_additive
assertions.source: max over the 5 recorded pairs of |tabulated Vol(L₁⊔L₂) − (Vol(L₁)+Vol(L₂))| = 0.0; gate 1e-58 is the 60-dps serialization round-trip bound on the largest tabulated volume, not a chosen band

assertions.name: geom_epsilon_coefficient_is_linear_in_N
assertions.source: max over N ∈ [1, 2, 5, 10, 100, 1000] of |tabulated coefficient − N/ℏ_q²| = 2.1365e-65, with 1/ℏ_q² = 101.8621786045972 recomputed at substrate precision; gate 1e-54 is the 60-dps serialization round-trip bound at N = 1000, not a chosen band

description: Route-B probe for conj:casimir-epsilon-vacuum: verify Hoefsmit Geom additivity on disjoint unions of unknots.  Step 1: record hyperbolic-volume additivity (well-known, Thurston).  Step 2: derive the symbolic form Geom_ε(N·⊙) = N · ε / ℏ_q² under the ε-relaxed vacuum axiom and tabulate the real-part coefficient for several N.  Step 3: dimensional cross-check against the conjecture's A/d³ scaling — uncovers that the surreal-infinitesimal birthday rank of N⊙ may be ε⁻² rather than ε⁻¹ once the ℏ_q² normalisation in VolDensity is accounted for; this is a refinement to carry back into the conjecture .md.

dimensional_consistency_check.implication: The conjecture's N⊙ ~ ε⁻¹ · A/d³ scaling may need refinement: dimensional analysis with the VolDensity = Vol/ℏ_q² normalisation suggests N⊙ ~ ε⁻² · A/d³, with the extra ε⁻¹ factor absorbing the ℏ_q² denominator.
dimensional_consistency_check.follow_up: Recompute the conditional Casimir derivation under the ε⁻² scaling and confirm π²/(240 d⁴) still falls out.

caveats: RESOLVED 2026-08-30 — kept as provenance, since this probe is where the defect surfaced. VOL_4_1_50DPS_STR in experimental_constants.py used to agree with 2·Cl₂(π/3) only to ~36 significant digits (gap 2.95e-36): it read …0854904057483004… where the true continuation is …0854904057188337…, under a name promising 50. It now carries the value qou-substrate computes (VOL_FIGURE_EIGHT_50_STR = nstr(2·clsin(2, π/3), 50) at 60 dps), gap 4.16e-52, and this probe's gate was tightened 1e-33 → 1e-45 to match its Borromean sibling. Why it stood: scripts/known-constant-literal-audit.py flags the old literal on sight, but its default roots are content/ computations/ scripts/ docs/ and the file is under qou-mass/ — never scanned. Fixing the string does not fix that gap in coverage.
